title: Mygelonian Flavoured
description: A Resource Pack made to tweak personal gripes with Vanilla Minecraft
body:
This Resource Pack aims to change small things I dislike about Vanilla Minecraft. Features include:

- Creeper Texture/Model (Requires [EMF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features))
- Randomized Bookshelves, with Biome Dependant Books & unique, connected top/bottom textures. (Requires [Polytone](https://modrinth.com/mod/polytone) & [Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity))
- 3D Furnace
- Unique textures for Buttons, Fences, and Pressure Plates.

I plan on adding to this Pack more in the future, but it's in a state now where I'm happy enough to publish it.
